source_title: We're Transferring the Stripe Sync Engine to Stripe
claim_summary: Supabase moves its open-source Stripe Sync Engine repository from supabase/stripe-sync-engine to stripe/sync-engine; stays Apache-2.0; dashboard one-click integration continues; Stripe engineers had contributed incremental sync and backfill
availability: repository transferred; GitHub API resolves supabase/stripe-sync-engine to stripe/sync-engine (Apache-2.0)
limitation: Transfer verified via GitHub API redirect only; downstream user impact and future maintenance not observed; contributor counts not measured

source_title: [Public Alpha] Declarative Schema Management with pg-delta
claim_summary: CLI ships pg-delta, Supabase's own TypeScript Postgres schema-diff engine (Postgres 15+ only), and an experimental declarative-schema workflow behind a flag; replaces reliance on migra/pgAdmin diffing
availability: experimental flag; @supabase/pg-delta 1.0.0-alpha.12 on npm 2026-04-15T08:45Z (MIT); 48 alpha versions published in window
limitation: Vendor says 'things will break, coverage is not complete'; diff correctness not tested by us; build-vs-reuse rationale (no fit among existing diff tools) is the vendor's own

source_title: Supabase is now ISO 27001 certified
claim_summary: Supabase states it is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 covering Database, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions and Data API; certificate available to Team/Enterprise plans from the dashboard
limitation: Certificate, scope statement and certification body not seen; ISO 27001 certifies a management system, not product security or customer configurations

source_title: Feature Preview: RLS Tester
claim_summary: Dashboard feature preview to run SQL as an impersonated anonymous or signed-in user and see which RLS policies are evaluated; client-library code is translated to SQL by the AI Assistant; only SELECT supported
limitation: AI-inferred SQL translation explicitly needs user verification per vendor; mutation testing excluded; no accuracy evaluation published

source_title: Introducing the OSSCAR Index
claim_summary: Supabase and >commit launch a quarterly ranking of fastest-growing open-source GitHub organizations (Q1 2026 edition) combining net new stars, unique contributors and npm/PyPI/Cargo downloads with an L2-norm composite in Emerging (<1,000 stars) and Scaling divisions; code and data on GitHub
availability: live; commitvc/osscar repository MIT (created 2026-03-20; last push 2026-07-26 with Q2 release checksums)
limitation: Ranks growth in stars/contributors/downloads, which this study does not treat as verified use or value; vendor-sponsored ranking; method not independently replicated here

source_title: Breaking Change: Tables not exposed to Data and GraphQL API automatically
claim_summary: New public-schema tables stop receiving automatic anon/authenticated/service_role grants: opt-in at project creation from 2026-04-28, stated default for new projects from 2026-05-30 (gradual), planned for all existing projects 2026-10-30; missing grants return error 42501 with a GRANT hint
availability: staged rollout; existing-project step 2026-10-30 is after the window
limitation: Rollout to new projects is vendor-stated, not observed; existing-project step is planned only; UpGuard (2026-09-24) still describes programmatically created tables as lacking RLS by default (different control, unreconciled)

source_title: Branching Without Git Is Now The Default
claim_summary: Dashboard (Git-free) branching leaves feature preview and is on by default for all projects; pg-delta replaces migra as default diff engine for dashboard branching; branches created via the Supabase MCP server use dashboard branching
feature: Git-free database branching for humans and agents
limitation: Vendor statement; merge/diff correctness not tested; Git-based branching remains supported

source_title: Introducing @supabase/server
claim_summary: New MIT package wraps auth verification, user/admin client creation, CORS and request context for Edge Functions, Vercel Functions, Cloudflare Workers, Hono and Bun; motivated by anonymised analysis of 25,000 deployed Edge Functions showing repeated boilerplate
availability: blog says public beta; npm 1.0.0 published 2026-05-06T09:27Z (MIT); 1.9.2 on 2026-10-12
limitation: Blog 'public beta' label vs npm 1.0.0 version recorded, not resolved; 25,000-function analysis unpublished; Supabase Evals (Jul 31) reports agents still hand-roll auth instead of using it

source_title: chore(monorepo): move CLI sources under apps/cli-go/
claim_summary: Monorepo consolidation commit renames the MIT LICENSE file from the repository root to apps/cli-go/LICENSE; on 2026-10-16 the GitHub API reports no repository-level licence for supabase/cli while npm package 'supabase' declares MIT
limitation: Observed effect on automated licence detection only; not a licence change; legal licence status of new monorepo packages not reviewed

source_title: Supabase Is Now an Official ChatGPT App
claim_summary: Official ChatGPT app with 29 tools (SQL, schema changes, Edge Function deploys, branching, logs, docs search) for all Supabase plans and paid ChatGPT plans
limitation: OpenAI-side listing not read; destructive-tool safeguards at this date not documented in the post

source_title: Breaking change in pg_graphql 1.6.0 - GraphQL introspection disabled by default
claim_summary: GraphQL introspection disabled by default from pg_graphql 1.6.0 for new projects; opt-in via schema comment; edit dated 2026-06-13 moved rollout from 2026-06-15 to 2026-06-29
availability: new projects from 2026-06-29 (stated); existing projects only on upgrade
limitation: Rollout not observed; date was revised once (recorded, not resolved); breaks schema-driven tooling (GraphiQL, codegen) until opt-in

source_title: Protecting your Supabase projects from npm supply chain attacks
claim_summary: Supabase reports a typosquat package 'supabase-javascript' that it reported and npm removed, and lists in-flight hardening (pinned GitHub Action SHAs across the org, pull_request_target review, security TSDoc) plus user guidance (pnpm 11 minimumReleaseAge, lockfiles, ignore-scripts)
availability: guidance published; org-wide SHA pinning described as close to enforced
limitation: npm registry shows supabase-javascript created 2026-05-12T17:49Z and versions 2.98.2/2.98.3 unpublished 2026-05-13T10:50Z (~17h) vs post's 'a few hours later' (unpublish time may differ from takedown); download counts not verified; Actions pinning not audited

source_title: Changes to Email Template Customisation on Free Tier
claim_summary: After six months of coordinated phishing abuse of free-tier auth email templates sent through Supabase SMTP, new free-tier projects using the default email provider can no longer edit auth email templates; existing projects keep theirs
limitation: Abuse volume and effect not quantified publicly; vendor's claim to be the only provider offering both features unverified

source_title: Supabase Series F

source_title: Vibe-coding phenomenon lifts AI startup Supabase to $10.5 billion valuation
claim_summary: CNBC reports $500M at $10.5B including new capital, valuation roughly doubled since October 2025; CEO says Claude Code and Codex account for the majority of databases with Claude Code the largest contributor in 2026; over 250,000 customers and 350 employees

source_title: Multigres v0.1 Alpha: an operating system for Postgres
claim_summary: Open-source-only Multigres v0.1 alpha with consensus-based HA on Postgres replication, two-tier connection pooling and a Kubernetes operator; Vitess-grade sharding promised for a later release
availability: GitHub release multigres/multigres v0.1.0 published 2026-05-30T00:08Z (Apache-2.0); not production-ready

source_title: Expired JWTs with string exp are accepted by REST broadcast authorization
claim_summary: REST broadcast endpoints accepted an expired JWT whose exp claim was a JSON string, allowing broadcasts after expiry; CVE-2026-54238, severity low
limitation: Exploitation and hosted-platform exposure window not stated; advisory read via GitHub API only

source_title: Incorrect Authorization in supabase/realtime
claim_summary: Realtime Authorization did not honour presence.read RLS under specific conditions, leaking presence metadata to presence-write-authorized members of private channels; CVE-2026-62247, severity medium
limitation: Requires a specific policy configuration; real-world impact unknown

source_title: Agentic Coding on Supabase with OpenCode
claim_summary: Open-source OpenCode plugin (built with pgflow's maintainer) lets the agent list/create Supabase projects, bundles Supabase agent skills and guides MCP setup; requires OpenCode 1.3.4+
limitation: OpenCode star/MAU figures (180,000 stars, 7.5M MAU) and named users are vendor-quoted, not verified; plugin licence not checked

source_title: Project status change failures in multiple regions
claim_summary: Project creation, resizing, branch provisioning and restarts failed across multiple regions from 2026-06-30 02:38 UTC (capacity shortage, still limited in ap-northeast-2, ap-south-1, eu-north-1 that day); incident held open until resolution 2026-07-13 16:00 UTC
limitation: No postmortem read; duration reflects vendor's choice to hold the incident open; status times displayed in UTC per page rendering

source_title: Realtime schema is now fully locked down against modifications
claim_summary: Realtime v2.112.7 makes destructive DDL/DML on the realtime schema fail with permission denied (except RLS policies on realtime.messages) to stop customer changes breaking Realtime migrations
limitation: May break user scripts that previously modified the schema; rollout to all hosted projects not observed

source_title: Self-hosted Supabase: Envoy becomes the default API gateway (breaking change)
claim_summary: Default self-hosted API gateway moves from Kong to Envoy the week of 2026-08-09; Kong becomes an opt-in override; rationale: OSS Kong 3.9.x is security-backport only and Kong removed free (unlicensed) mode in 3.10
availability: announced for week of 2026-08-09; Kong remains opt-in
limitation: Vendor's characterisation of Kong's OSS line not independently checked; the Aug 9 switch was not observed in the docker-compose history

source_title: Supabase Pipelines is now in Public Alpha
claim_summary: Managed CDC replication to analytics destinations moves to public alpha (BigQuery first), powered by open-source Rust supabase/etl; adds automatic schema-change propagation and at-least-once delivery; 2026-10-02 update adds ClickHouse, DuckLake and Snowflake in public alpha
limitation: Delivery guarantees not tested; post was edited after the window (Oct 2 update note)

source_title: Extension version pinning is deprecated in favor of default versions
claim_summary: From 2026-08-05, CREATE/ALTER EXTENSION ... VERSION clauses are ignored with a warning and the default version installed, to stop projects reinstalling extension versions with known vulnerabilities; future rejection announced
limitation: Breaks reproducible migrations that pin extension versions; effect not observed

source_title: Sign in with ChatGPT is in beta on Supabase
claim_summary: Supabase is a launch partner for OpenAI's Sign in with ChatGPT beta: create or link a Supabase account with a ChatGPT identity (auto-link by matching email, SSO excluded) and connect the ChatGPT/Codex plugin with a consent step
limitation: Automatic email-based account linking is a security-relevant design choice not reviewed here; OpenAI-side documentation not read

source_title: Introducing Supabase Evals
claim_summary: Open-sources supabase/evals, running Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode against real Supabase tasks scored by deterministic checks plus LLM-as-judge with one retry; reports skills raised Sonnet 5 78%->100% and GPT-5.6 Sol 89%->100% (Build stage), Claude Code consulted docs in under 40% of scenarios, and agents avoided @supabase/server and declarative schemas
feature: vendor agent benchmark and regression suite
availability: repo supabase/evals Apache-2.0 (created 2026-04-30); no GitHub releases
limitation: Vendor-authored tasks and judge (self-evaluation); small scenario counts; retry-once and LLM-judge scoring; results are a dated snapshot; not replicated by us

source_title: Are Supabase docs agent-friendly? We didn't know, so we checked
claim_summary: Supabase reports running an eval on its RLS guide (56,974 pageviews/90 days; 31% of readers find it unhelpful; security is 26% of tickets): agents following it left anon write grants on all tables until guidance was revised; moving test examples next to copied code made the eval pass
availability: process change; RLS scenario moving into public benchmark
limitation: Page datePublished is 2026-08-01 but text cites results 'through August 16' and HN first linked it 2026-09-08 (date conflict recorded, not resolved); single guide; vendor-designed checklist

source_title: Systemic Risks in the Managed PostgreSQL Industry, part 1: extension risks are real
claim_summary: Independent researcher reports an out-of-bounds write in PostGIS address_standardizer chained to superuser and RCE in production on NeonDB, Supabase, Xata and others, and says an earlier cross-tenant issue affecting Supabase was fixed within 30 minutes
feature: third-party extension risk on managed Postgres
availability: researcher says upstream fix merged; vendor remediation details not published by Supabase
limitation: Single researcher's self-report; no Supabase statement found; CVE identifiers cited by the author not checked against NVD; page modified 2026-09-08

source_title: Unauthenticated log injection / terminal escape injection via OpenTelemetry baggage header
claim_summary: Unvalidated request-id from the W3C baggage header was written into logs, allowing unauthenticated log/terminal-escape injection; severity low (advisory text states CVSS 5.3)
limitation: Advisory metadata severity 'low' vs body 'Medium / CVSS 5.3' (recorded)

source_title: Enterprise-managed auth for the Supabase MCP server
claim_summary: Enterprise-managed auth for the Supabase MCP server GA on Team/Enterprise (with Anthropic and Okta): admins authorize the connector once and access in Claude follows each employee's existing Supabase role; SCIM provisioning on roadmap
availability: GA; requires Okta SSO and Claude Team/Enterprise
limitation: Plan-gated; access-control behaviour not tested

source_title: Projects failing to load Supautils in multiple regions
claim_summary: PostgreSQL 15 projects failed to load supautils.so because GLIBC_2.33 was unavailable on affected hosts, disrupting database access in multiple regions until a rollback
limitation: Start time and number of affected projects not shown on the page; no postmortem read

source_title: Auth Service Outage
claim_summary: Partial outage of the Auth service for a subset of projects from 07:17 to 09:33 UTC on 2026-09-16
limitation: Status history before mid-July only partly reachable; affected-project share not stated

source_title: Client-supplied bytes are spliced unvalidated into other subscribers' JSON frames
claim_summary: High-severity advisory: V2 binary user broadcasts were spliced unvalidated into other subscribers' JSON frames, letting any broadcaster forge Realtime protocol events (including postgres_changes) on a channel; reporter demonstrated it on supabase/realtime v2.137.14
availability: affected <=2.137.14; patched-version field empty in advisory
limitation: No patched version recorded in advisory metadata at access; hosted-platform remediation date not stated

source_title: Everything Everywhere: Systemic Data Exposure in Supabase Apps
claim_summary: UpGuard fingerprinted ~300,000 domains using Supabase and found 16,326 databases exposing readable tables, over half with PII indicators; attributes exposure to customer misconfiguration amplified by AI coding agents and notes programmatically created tables do not enable RLS by default
limitation: Page JSON-LD datePublished 2026-09-24 vs displayed 'Publish date October 14, 2026' (recorded); vendor security firm with commercial interest; method uses third-party datasets and AI classification; not replicated

source_title: Some Supabase customers are publicly exposing reams of people's data to the web
claim_summary: TechCrunch reports UpGuard's finding of around 16,000 exposing databases; Supabase CISO Bil Harmer says projects are 'secure by default' and security is a shared responsibility
limitation: Same underlying research as UpGuard row (one finding, two documents); Supabase had not seen the research when commenting

source_title: PostgreSQL 15.19 / 17.11 minor release - action may be required
claim_summary: Rollout of PostgreSQL 15.19/17.11 (from 15.14/17.6) bundling five upstream security cycles that Supabase says close 44 CVEs; possible action for ltree and btree_gist reindexing, pgcrypto legacy-cipher PGP (CVE-2026-14663) and custom operator selectivity estimators (CVE-2026-2004)
limitation: CVE count and IDs are vendor-stated and not checked against NVD; rollout timing per project not observed

source_title: Logs usage-based pricing

availability: soft launch; not enforced in window
limitation: Prices and limits not extracted here; 90% figure unverified

source_title: OrioleDB is now in Public Beta with paid plans and paid features

availability: public beta, not for production; orioledb/orioledb Apache-2.0 GitHub release beta19 on 2026-10-01

claim_summary: Supabase announces it is acquiring Turso (SQLite rewritten in Rust; cloud managing millions of databases per server) to give agents cheap on-demand databases with a path to Postgres; says it already launches over one million databases per week; Glauber Costa to lead the agentic-infrastructure effort
